P.name: Power Chord
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate - Accelerando:}} '''Sona''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Accelerando'' each time she hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} with ''{{ai|Hymn of Valor|Sona}}'' and each time she mitigates sufficient damage or heals damaged allies with ''{{ai|Aria of Perseverance|Sona}}'', stacking up to 120 times. At maximum stacks, she instead reduces the {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} of ''{{ai|Crescendo|Sona}}'' by {{fd|1.5}} seconds each time.

[[File:Power Chord.png|20px|border|link=]] {{sbc|Accelerando:}} For each stack, '''Sona''' gains {{sti|{{as|{{fd|0.5}} basic ability haste}}}}, up to {{as|60|ah}} at maximum stacks.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Melody:}} Whenever '''Sona''' casts a {{tip|ability|basic ability}}, her other basic abilities incur a {{sti|cd|{{fd|0.5}}-second}} global cooldown and she generates a unique {{tip|aura}} for 3 seconds that empowers herself and nearby allied champions. Only one aura can be active at a time.
P.description3:
{{sbc|Innate - Power Chord:}} '''Sona's''' basic abilities generate a stack of ''Power Chord'', stacking up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, her next {{tip|basic attack}}<!--not on-hit--> is empowered to consume them all to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, deal {{as|{{pp|20 to 80 for 7;90 + (240-90)/10*(x-1) for 13|formula=10 + 10 per level until level 8, then + 15 per level}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, and apply an additional effect based on the last basic ability she cast:
* ''{{ai|Hymn of Valor|Sona}}'' - {{sbc|Staccato:}} '''Bonus''' damage is modified to {{as|{{pp|20*1.5 to 80*1.5 for 7;90*1.5 + (240*1.5-90*1.5)/10*(x-1) for 13|formula=15 + 15 per level until level 8, then + 22.5 per level}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}.
* ''{{ai|Aria of Perseverance|Sona}}'' - {{sbc|Diminuendo:}} Reduces the target's {{tip|size}} by 8% and damage dealt by 25% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 AP)}} for 3 seconds.
* ''{{ai|Song of Celerity|Sona}}'' - {{sbc|Tempo:}} {{tip|Slows}} the target by 50% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 AP)}} for 2 seconds, capped at 99%.
P.description4: ''Gaining Power Chord's empowered attack {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Sona's''' basic attack timer.''

Q.name: Hymn of Valor
Q.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Sona''' sends out bolts of sound to the two nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies, prioritizing champions. Each bolt deals {{as|magic damage}} and grants {{tip|sight}} of the area around the target for 1 second.

'''Sona''' gains a stack of ''{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Accelerando}}'' for each bolt that hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}.
Q.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Melody|image=*none*}} Bonus:}} '''Sona''' and tagged allied champions deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} on their next attack {{tip|on-hit}} within 5 seconds.

W.name: Aria of Perseverance
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sona''' {{tip|heals}} herself and sends out a tone to heal the {{tt|most wounded|Based on greatest % missing health}} allied champion nearby.
W.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Melody|image=*none*}} Bonus:}} '''Sona''' and tagged allied champions are granted a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
W.description3: '''Sona''' gains a stack of ''{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Accelerando}}'' whenever she {{tip|heals}} a wounded ally or {{tip|shields}} a minimum amount of damage for an ally with ''Aria of Perseverance''.

E.name: Song of Celerity
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sona''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|20%|ms}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 7 seconds. If she takes damage during this time, the duration ends prematurely once or if 3 seconds have elapsed.
E.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Melody|image=*none*}} Bonus:}} Tagged allied champions gain {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} for 3 seconds.
E.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|10 to 18}}% {{as|(+ 2% per 100 of '''Sona's''' AP)}}}}

R.name: Crescendo
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sona''' strikes an irresistible chord in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|stuns}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
